name: Residence Permit for Business

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a shareholding in a company registered in Estonia's Business Register, with at least EUR 65,000 invested in that company's activities.
requirements.fix_path: Invest at least EUR 65,000 in the Estonian company's activities.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires sufficient income to support yourself in Estonia, set at six times the national subsistence level.
requirements.fix_path: Document income at or above six times the current subsistence level.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires prior evaluation by an expert committee of the Ministry of the Interior confirming the company qualifies as a start-up (decided within 10 working days), unless the company is already evaluated or on an exemption list.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain start-up qualification approval from the Ministry of the Interior's expert committee.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires sufficient income to support yourself in Estonia, set at four times the national subsistence level.
requirements.fix_path: Document income at or above four times the current subsistence level.

evidence_required.document: Business Register company registration, proof of investment amount (shareholder route)
Start-up committee approval letter (start-up entrepreneur route)

outcome.duration_length: up to 5 years initially, extendable up to 10 years at a time
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: must register a residential address in Estonia's Population Register after approval.

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board of Estonia (politsei.ee) -- Residence permit for business

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Estonia's initial build. This is ONE government-named residence permit reached via multiple genuinely different qualifying grounds, modelled as OR-logic groups rather than fake separate routes -- the source page names four categories in total (company shareholders, sole proprietors, start-up entrepreneurs, large investors) but only shareholder and start-up-entrepreneur terms were confirmed in enough detail in this pass to encode; sole-proprietor and large-investor grounds are a known, flagged gap, not silently omitted. This is what is commonly marketed as the 'Estonia Startup Visa' -- distinct from e-Residency (which grants no residence right at all) and from the Digital Nomad Visa (which is a short-term, non-renewable visa with no path anywhere, unlike this permit's 5-to-10-year renewable structure and onward links to long-term residence and naturalisation).
